how_to_read: Rows are (carrier, classification) pairs; cells are floors.
`baseline: refused` means the carrier does not accept this classification at all, so no floor there is observable; `refusal_signature` pins WHICH refusal was seen.
`fires` means breaking that floor's input flips the carrier's own verdict AND the carrier's report attributes the refusal to that floor.
`skipped-by-design` means the carrier accepts the input and ignores it, for a stated reason.
`input-refused` means the carrier refuses the input outright, so the floor can never read it. It does NOT mean that refusal is the only thing keeping the floor inert -- read the cell reason.
`undispositioned` means inert with no reason that makes it deliberate; it must name a filed issue.
Every state pins exactly one observation. An absent pair or cell is a refusal, not a default.

not_measured.closeout_authorization: the protected-target crosswalk instance was RETIRED by operator ruling on 2026-08-10, so no probe can make this floor fire without rebuilding the artifact that ruling retired. A row that can never fire is the shape #586 exists to remove, so it is named here rather than declared as cells.
not_measured.issue_owned_behavioral_floor_on_release: on `release-draft` the behavioral-verdict cells measure the RELEASE lane's own floor, which refuses first. Any input that would break the issue-owned `evaluate_behavioral_verdict` downstream also empties the release channel, so that floor is structurally SHADOWED on this carrier: unwire it entirely and all six release cells read unchanged. This is a real property of the lane, not a probe limitation, and it is the reason the release behavioral cells carry a carrier-specific reason rather than a classification one.
not_measured.resolution_critique_observer_arm: the close-blocking observer arm (`_observer_refusals` / `repo_requires_delegated_observer`) is NOT exercised. The probe bodies bind their critique with `Critique: blocked <signal>`, which the shared helper records under `skipped` rather than as resolved evidence, so `fresh_eye_observer` is None and the refusal set is always empty. The probe world carries the repo's `AGENTS.md` so the delegation question is answered the way this repo answers it, but no declared cell moves on that arm and a change to it is invisible to this gate.
not_measured.ledger_fields_on_close_with_comment: `evaluate_close_comment_floor` applies `_missing_ledger_fields` ONLY to `consolidated`, while `verify_closeout` applies it to every classification. `issue_close_comment_floor.py` names this as deliberate scope restraint awaiting its own before/after. It is instance 2 of #586 living in a module docstring, it is NOT a row here, and a green gate over these 36 pairs must not be read as covering it.
not_measured.three_of_the_four_consolidation_facts: the readback checks that the destination EXISTS, is OPEN, NAMES this issue, and is not itself a consolidation. Only the OPEN check is probed (by moving the destination to CLOSED). The other three are unmeasured.
not_measured.bundle_closes: every probe closes a SINGLE issue, so the per-issue `Behavior #N:` / `Critique #N:` binding grammar is only ever exercised through its single-issue shorthand branch. Multi-issue closeouts are unmeasured.
not_measured.commit-msg sub-paths: the `commit-msg` carrier is probed on its BARE close-keyword path only. Its staged-artifact path (classification read from `charness-artifacts/issue/*.md` rather than the message) and its pause-brief path (which remaps a floor-exempt classification to `feature` before checking AI-provenance) are separate paths this matrix does not measure.
not_measured.draft-vs-verify ingress: `direct-commit`, `pr-body` and `manual-fallback` are probed through `verify_closeout`. `release-draft` reaches the sibling `validate_closeout_draft`, which remaps `direct-commit` to the `pr-body` rule set -- so five of the six release cells re-observe the `pr-body` rule set rather than an independent one, and the release lane passes `backend={}` so no backend-touching floor is genuinely exercised there.
not_measured.reason prose: the gate compares declared states to observations. No `reason` string is checked against behavior.
not_measured.sufficiency: a `fires` cell says the floor reaches the verdict. It says nothing about whether the floor is correct, and must not be read as evidence that a running floor is a sufficient one.
